messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Incident 1739002468 - Elevated 5xx/401 spike across auth-proxy in us-west-2. Paging @noah (oncall) and @Aisha (sre).

noah (oncall): ack. seeing large increase in 401 and 502s for /v1/embeddings and /v1/generate. Triage starting - checking auth-proxy logs, auth-cache, and audit-log collector.

Aisha (sre): I'm on collector side. early sign: the audit-log ingestion pipeline lagged and a validation job started rejecting messages which caused the auth service to fail fast on token validation. rolling restart of collector pods now.

ben-sre: launching throttling rules to reduce load on auth-proxy: `redwoodctl runpolicy set auth-proxy --rate 200rps --burst 50` and enabling short-circuit cache for enterprise tokens.

noah (oncall): good. enabling cache bypass: route validation to in-memory-token-cache for 90s TTL for enterprise keys to reduce calls to collector.

deploy-bot: Auto-redeploy auth-collector-rc v2.3.1 triggered by manual restart at 1739002990.

Maya_sec: Hi team - security note: preserve audit-collector input stream, API gateway logs, IAM events and any token issuance logs. We need chain-of-custody if we escalate. I also see an unusual drop in audit ingestion around 2026-04-12T03:10Z -> 03:40Z from sampling dashboard. Can someone export that window?

Aisha (sre): grabbing exports now. running:
```
# export kafka topic for audit pipeline
kafka-dump --topic audit-events --from-ts 2026-04-12T03:00:00Z --to-ts 2026-04-12T04:00:00Z > /tmp/audit-1739002468.ndjson
gsutil cp /tmp/audit-1739002468.ndjson gs://redwood-incidents/1739002468/
```

noah (oncall): customer impact summary (for handoff): ~25% of requests to embeddings returned 502/401 between 03:08 and 03:36 UTC in us-west-2. Several production customers reported timeouts and one support ticket escalated. No sign of data exfiltration; issue appears internal to validation pipeline.

ben-sre: auth-proxy 5xxs are trending down after cache enable + collector restart. queue depth back to normal. continuing to monitor.

Maya_sec: please also snapshot KMS access logs and any `getPublicKey` / `sign` operations for the window and store in evidence bucket. Record checksums and operator names.

noah (oncall): evidence bucket created: gs://redwood-incidents/1739002468. please put checksums in the metadata file.

ops-tooling: adding automated evidence capture job: `opsctl evidence capture --incident 1739002468 --resources api-gateway,audit-collector,kms --output gs://redwood-incidents/1739002468/`

Aisha (sre): collector logs show a null pointer exception in message validator which caused consumer to stop committing offsets for ~22m. hypothesis: bad validation rule pushed in the pipeline earlier today. creating ticket SRE-9122 to track.

Maya_sec: If a bad rule was pushed we need change history + who applied it. export Cloud Audit for config changes and post here. Also rotate any service account keys that might have been used to push config changes (after evidence captured).

noah (oncall): will do. pulling Cloud Audit for deployment/user actions 02:30-04:30Z.

ben-sre: collector restarted and auto-recovery seems healthy. rolling back the validator change to previous stable rule set and pausing config deploys to pipeline until postmortem.

deploy-bot: Rollback completed by ben-sre at 1739004122.

noah (oncall): marking incident as mitigated once error-rate < baseline. currently error-rate back to norm. prepping post-incident items.

incident-bot: Incident mitigated at 1739004300.

noah (oncall): Planning postmortem + timeline. Proposed timeline:
- 2026-04-13 15:00 UTC - postmortem meeting (60m)
- doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INC/1739002468 (owner: ben-sre)
- JIRA epic: RDW-INC-5821 (post-incident remediations)

noah (oncall): initial action items (please ack & adjust due dates):
- A1 (owner: Aisha) - Fix validator NPE and add unit tests; due 2026-04-19.
- A2 (owner: ops-tooling) - Automate audit-stream snapshot on collector failures; due 2026-04-22.
- A3 (owner: ben-sre) - Add end-to-end integration test to deploy pipeline to catch bad validation rules; due 2026-04-26.
- A4 (owner: Maya_sec) - Review and harden service account permissions for pipeline deployer; rotate keys if any long-lived creds exist; due 2026-04-20.
- A5 (owner: Victor_legal) - Confirm notification requirements for affected customers and retention requirements for artifacts; due 2026-04-18.

Maya_sec: A4 ack. I've opened SEC-901 with preliminary findings: a pipeline deployer service account had edit-level access to validator configs. Suggest limiting to deploy-only role.

Aisha (sre): A1 ack. I'll attach failing stack traces in SRE-9122 and link unit test PR.

ben-sre: A3 ack. I'll start a small harness that runs the validator against a real sample of audit events as part of CI.

Victor_legal: A5 ack. I'll check regulatory requirements and whether we need customer notification; will coordinate with Support for messaging if needed.

noah (oncall): handoff plan: I'll run a short write-up and hand to ben-sre as incident owner for postmortem. keeping channel open for follow-ups.

ops-tooling: created JIRA epic RDW-INC-5821 and linked tickets: SRE-9122, SEC-901, OPS-4502.

incident-bot: Handoff recorded: from noah (oncall) to ben-sre at 1739004568.

Maya_sec: security follow-ups (added to SEC-901):
- collect and preserve: audit-collector input topic dump, API GW access logs, Cloud Audit logs for config changes, KMS operation logs, service account key list (and rotate any long-lived keys).
- implement alert: `audit-ingest-lag > 10m` and `validator-exceptions > 0` -> pager to sec-oncall and sre-oncall.

ben-sre: taking over. I'll host the postmortem and draft timeline in Confluence. scheduling tabletop with Product and Support next week to review customer comms.

noah (oncall): final operational note: ensure all artifacts in gs://redwood-incidents/1739002468 have SHA256 sums and a recorded owner for chain-of-custody. thanks all.

ben-sre: noted. closing mitigation activities, leaving this thread for postmortem updates and action item tracking. please update Jira as you make progress. :white_check_mark:
